description: Fort Oranje sits on the cliff above Oranjestad on Sint Eustatius, with a row of cannons along the parapet and the Lower Town roofs and warehouse ruins below. The bay is quiet. It is clear and warm, about 29.0°C, with a breeze near 20.7 km/h and no rain. Sunset was 18:05 America/Kralendijk, so 18:19 is dusk, about fourteen minutes after sunset, with afterglow still over the sea.
